ja: • ゲームにアニメ、新ウォッチ、さらに冬には映画公開も!!盛り上がる妖怪ウォッチから新妖怪登場!!
• USAをヒッチハイクで旅する仲のよい双子の兄弟妖怪の兄、KKブラザーズKコマーがプラモで登場!!
• キュートな小物とオリジナルシールで遊べる！
• コミカルなセリフプレートが付属!!
• 愛用のスケッチブックはシールを貼り換え遊べる仕様に!!
• 水筒はリュックと手で組み換え遊びが可能。
• 充実の表情パーツ＆シール。
• KKブラザーズKジーロも発売決定。ベースは、Kジーロと連結可能!!
成形品×5、シール×1、組立説明書×1
en: • Games, anime, new watches, and even a movie to be released in winter! New Yokai appear from the exciting Yokai Watch!
• The KK Brothers Kcomer, the older brother of the ghostly twin brothers who hitchhike around the USA, is now available as a plastic model!!
• You can play with cute accessories and original Seals!
• A comical dialogue plate is included!!
• Your favorite sketchbook now has a Seal that you can play with!
• The water bottle can be combined and played with the backpack and hands.
• Full range of facial expression parts and seals.
• KK Brothers K Giro has also been decided to be released. The base can be connected to K-Giro!!
Molded product x 5, Seal x 1, Assembly manual x 1
